use: Hero shot of one product: it turns on a studio floor while the camera pushes in or orbits. Use for launch films, product reveals and feature intros.

model.description: Product model (.glb, .gltf, .obj or .fbx). Empty uses the placeholder shape.

shape.description: Placeholder shape when no model is given.

turnDegrees.description: How far the product turns; it ends a quarter of this past front-facing, in a three-quarter hero pose.

cameraMove.description: push moves toward the product; orbit circles it; static holds.

ease.description: Keyframe easing for camera and product.

hdri.description: "studio" for built-in three-point lighting, or a Poly Haven HDRI id (CC0), e.g. studio_small_09, downloaded on first use.
